Definition: from G1909 and G1166; to exhibit (physically or mentally):--shew.
BiblicalUsage: Epideiknymi means to show, to exhibit, to prove by showing. Show me the tribute money, Jesus says; go show yourselves unto the priests, He tells the lepers; Apollos mightily convinced the Jews, showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was Christ; and God, willing to show the immutability of His counsel, confirmed it by an oath.
TheologicalSignificance: God shows rather than merely says, and each proof is evidence you can look at: the coin, the cleansed skin, the Scriptures, the oath. I believe showing is His way with doubters, and I should answer questions the same way — with something to see, not only something to hear.
RelatedEvents: The Healing of the Ten Lepers; Apollos Taught at Ephesus
